description: Self-contained macOS-style Dynamic Island for Windows with media controls, dashboard, calendar, timer, file shelf, system information, and quick actions.
notes: The upstream release workflow archives the contents of its self-contained win-x64 publish directory; WinDynamicIsland.exe is at the archive root and the .NET/Windows App SDK runtime is bundled.
Settings, notes, shelf data, and logs are stored under %LOCALAPPDATA%\WinDynamicIsland. The optional Run-at-startup setting is controlled by the application and is not enabled by this manifest.
